title: AI-GENERATED CODE == CODE YOU CAN TRUST?
description:
Click here to follow AI Singapore's online community on Discord for updates
The hard part about AI-generated code is making it reliable. How do you create agents that hold up in production, and produce code you can trust when a machine wrote it?
We'll look at it from two fronts:
Harness engineering — the scaffolding that turns a model into an agent. Only one layer of an AI agent is the model; the rest is the harness — orchestration, memory, tool design, evaluation, retries, observability. The scaffolding that turns a capable model into a dependable autonomous agent + a look at DeepSeek's…
